job.title: Backend Software Engineer - Go / Golang
job.description: HyperScale Networks in Pune builds high-throughput networking proxies and cloud services. We seek a Fresher or Junior Go Engineer with a solid foundation in Goroutines, channels, pointers, HTTP net/http, and microservices architectures. Prior experience with Docker and gRPC is a big plus.
